title: Rights basis: the dates, permitted uses and deletion-on-end that govern a source and everything made from it
description: A rights basis attaches to an original, a reviewed release or a managed connection target. Each attach or renewal is a numbered version; a stored revision is bound to the versions it was made under and keeps them (a renewal binds only what is made after it). Made from several sources, a revision may be used until the earliest end, for the uses every source permits, and is deleted at the end when any source asks.

targets.label: An original kept in the project

end.stored_as: the first instant after the last permitted day (00:00 UTC of the next day)
